messages.author: 454cb9f24c96878e
messages.subject: The application failed to start
parts:
I have successfully deployed my first application: http://aakash.shinyapps.io/mySapp/

However, I am getting the following error message:
Loading required package: rCharts Loading required package: bitops Warning in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open compressed file '/var/shiny-server/www/mySapp/dfs.rda', probable reason 'No such file or directory' Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open the connection Calls: runApp ... startAppDir -> sys.source -> eval -> eval -> load -> readChar Execution halted

Does this mean that Shiny doesn't recognize rda file?
In both server.R and ui.R, I am loading the rda file as: load('/var/shiny-server/www/mySapp/dfs.rda')

When I try runApp(), I am able to get the required graphs. However, can not generate using shinyapps server.

It would be great if you confirm if loading RDA file is correct or is there any other way to load the data.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: The application failed to start
parts:
Aakash,

You should use relative paths when reading/writing files on ShinyApps. In other words you should do something like:

load('data.rda')

This is because ShinyApps does not install files that are part of an applicaiton to a fixed location as you would with shiny-server. 

-Andy
